I will keep this small plot simple because it is only 0.08 hectare and I own it, so I can use manure from home and family work instead of spending cash on a little chemical fertilizer there. On plots like this, especially when I intercrop, I usually keep local seed because it is easier to manage and I have seen it work for me before. I will not irrigate because here I mostly wait for the rains, and I will not hire labor for such a small piece.
